title: 第184章 李沐晴才不是什么弱女子！
slug: 班级求生我是大客车内唯一男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顾屿边操控小货车，边飞速分析着目前的情况。

他可以选择急刹车，通过惯性将眼前的猎人丧尸摔下车，再碾过去。

可后面不仅紧跟着小轿车，且小轿车后面有20来头C级猎人在追击着。

一旦自己突然刹车，肯定会和后面的小轿车相撞。

这样一来，自己和小轿车的速度都会骤降，甚至会翻车。

到时候自己和那群囚徒肯定会被猎人丧尸围了上来！

一旦载具被围着，那就完犊子了...

顾屿眯起眼睛，眉头皱起。

现在只剩下一个选择，那就是杀了这头C级的猎人丧尸！

但顾屿目前正驾驶着小货车，路上还时不时有零星几头猎人丧尸扑来，他不敢分心。

“屿哥！给我吧！我来！”李沐晴双手轻轻握着顾屿手里的匕首，声音很暖，也很坚决。

李沐晴她从来都不是什么弱女子。

她高二那年，为救一名18岁的外卖小哥，双腿被大货车碾压。

被截肢后，她依旧坚持坐着轮椅上学。

哪怕面对同学的嘲笑和孤立，她都能对所有人保持友善和开朗。

期间，她被推倒过好几次，她都能忍着泪水，坚强地重新站起来。

直到放学时，李沐晴推着轮椅迎着诧异的目光走出校门，看到每天都在门口等她的屿哥，委屈的泪水才会涌出。

当时顾屿问她怎么了，可李沐晴为了不让屿哥担心，只是默默地抱着蹲在眼前的顾屿。

她选择将一切不好的情绪藏在心里，自己硬扛。

她知道屿哥为了赚她的学费和生活费，已经很累了。

她只想给这个男生带来最好的情绪。

更何况，在高中毕业后，每当顾屿出去送外卖时，坐着轮椅的李沐晴不仅把家务活做了，还能自己外出接点手工活在家做。

她一做就是一整天，直到顾屿回来。

她只想让顾屿没那么大压力，也想为这个小家多尽一份力。

所以李沐晴的手经常会出血、红肿。

但她会在顾屿回来前处理好，不让顾屿担心。

李沐晴一直都努力藏起内心的坏情绪，尽力将好情绪分享给顾屿。

此时，趴在小货车前的猎人丧尸已经能将头探进来驾驶位了！

单手开车的顾屿死死盯着猎人丧尸，盯着它那被玻璃划开的脸。

黑褐色的腥臭血液浸满玻璃尖。

顾屿只思考了很短时间，就选择相信沐晴。

他将匕首交到李沐晴手里，很认真地嘱咐起来：

“你攻击力不够，只能攻击它的眼球！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Gu Yu quickly analyzed the current situation while controlling the pickup truck.

He could choose to brake suddenly, use inertia to throw the hunter zombie in front of him out of the car, and then run over it.

But not only was the car closely followed, but there were about 20 C-class hunters chasing behind the car.

Once you brake suddenly, you will definitely collide with the car behind you.

As a result, the speed of yourself and the car will drop sharply, and it may even overturn.

By then, he and the group of prisoners will definitely be surrounded by hunter zombies!

Once the vehicle is surrounded, it's over...

Gu Yu narrowed his eyes and frowned.

Now there is only one option left, and that is to kill this C-level hunter zombie!

But Gu Yu was currently driving a small truck, and there were sporadic hunter zombies rushing towards him on the road, so he didn't dare to be distracted.

"Brother Yu! Give it to me! I'll do it!" Li Muqing gently held the dagger in Gu Yu's hand with both hands, her voice was warm and firm.

Li Muqing has never been a weak woman.

In her sophomore year of high school, while trying to save an 18-year-old delivery boy, her legs were run over by a large truck.

After her leg was amputated, she still insisted on going to school in a wheelchair.

Even in the face of ridicule and isolation from her classmates, she remained friendly and cheerful to everyone.

During this period, she was pushed down several times, but she was able to hold back her tears and stand up again with strength.

It wasn't until school was over that Li Muqing pushed her wheelchair out of the school gate and faced surprised eyes. She saw Brother Yu who was waiting for her at the door every day, and tears of grievance came out.

At that time, Gu Yu asked her what was wrong, but in order not to worry Brother Yu, Li Muqing just silently hugged Gu Yu who was squatting in front of her.

She chose to hide all the bad emotions in her heart and carry them by herself.

She knew that Brother Yu was already very tired trying to earn her tuition and living expenses.

She just wanted to bring the best emotions to this boy.

What's more, after graduating from high school, whenever Gu Yu went out to deliver food, Li Muqing, who was in a wheelchair, not only did the housework, but also went out to do some handicrafts at home.

She did this all day long until Gu Yu came back.

She just wanted to make Gu Yu less stressed, and she also wanted to do more for this little family.

Therefore, Li Muqing's hands often bleed, become red and swollen.

But she will take care of it before Gu Yu comes back so that Gu Yu won't worry.

Li Muqing has always tried hard to hide her bad emotions and try her best to share her good emotions with Gu Yu.

At this time, the hunter zombie lying in front of the pickup truck was able to poke his head into the driver's seat!

Gu Yu, who was driving with one hand, stared at the hunter zombie, staring at its face cut open by the glass.

Dark brown fishy blood soaked the glass tip.

Gu Yu only thought about it for a short time before choosing to believe Mu Qing.

He handed the dagger to Li Muqing's hand and said seriously:

"You don't have enough attack power, you can only attack its eyeballs!"
